question: With a free CoinGecko Demo key, what HTTP status, body, headers (Retry-After, x-ratelimit-*) and reset moment does the API answer (a) past 100 calls a minute and (b) at 10,000 credits a month? Also: support.coingecko.com still says a Demo account has 30 calls a minute while the pricing page says 100.
why: A Demo key needs an account; a keyless burst measured only the public pool (429, Retry-After 60, JSON body). The monthly cut-off is documented only for the overage-enabled case.
